essence: The deity is visualized wearing a well-arranged crest of peacock feathers.
The deity is joyfully calling a tawny cow standing in the middle of the forest.
Worship of the group of eight must be preceded by worship of the mantra limbs.
The teaching identifies members such as Kāla and Karṇātmaka within the declared group of eight.
After the Indra-headed group, their weapons are to be addressed in the ritual.
